[0] Upgrading to a new phone often comes with a hidden expense: when your new and old iPhones are different sizes, you'll need to buy a new case.

[1] For users upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro, buying a new case is almost inevitable — but two accessory manufacturers have different views on this, with one even making a bold prediction…

[2] Bloomberg's Mark Gurman posted a photo of an Otterbox case on Twitter, saying the product is already on sale at Best Buy and is compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom right corner of the packaging states in English and French:

[3] Compatible with iPhone 18 Pro iPhone 17 Pro

[4] Gurman himself is not entirely convinced, adding that "it's a bit early to say." However, Matt Ronge of Astropad, which specializes in iPhone anti-glare screen protectors, said his suppliers have told him the same thing.

[5] Conflicting reports on iPhone Pro thickness

[6] Last year, leakers pointed out that at least the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. The reports did not mention the smaller Pro model, but information from iPhone suppliers suggests the iPhone 18 Pro will be two millimeters thicker than the previous generation.

[7] This trend appears to be continuing, as both iPhone 17 Pro models are thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

[8] However, not all leakers share the same view — some say the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be exactly the same thickness as last year's model.

[9] 9to5Mac's take

[10] Apple does sometimes provide dimensional information to partner case manufacturers in advance so that third-party cases can launch alongside new iPhones. On the other hand, accessory manufacturers have also been known to place production orders based purely on rumors, and sometimes the results aren't accurate. Personally, I wouldn't buy a case before the new iPhone is officially announced.
